title: RPC JSONL suite has a load-sensitive two-second receive timeout
claim: The rpc_jsonl test binary is nondeterministic under concurrent test load because multiple otherwise independent tests can exhaust the shared two-second RPC receive deadline.

evidence.detail: Every RPC receive uses one fixed two-second timeout.

evidence.location: audit command: cargo test -p opi-coding-agent --test rpc_jsonl --quiet
evidence.detail: Concurrent binary reruns were mixed: one failed in three different set_model tests, then two passed.

evidence.location: audit command: cargo test -p opi-coding-agent --test rpc_jsonl --quiet -- --test-threads=1
evidence.detail: Serial execution passed 80/80; the original test passed 5/5 alone.
